title: What the Hounds Dug Up
text: The kennel hounds have been digging all night under the east wall. They have found something, and they will not let anyone near it, and they will not stop whining.

options.label: Drive the hounds off and look.

outcomes.text: A child's skeleton, wearing your House's colors, centuries old. Nobody knows her name.
A chest of old coin, and a hand still holding the key.

options.label: Fill the hole and chain the hounds.

outcomes.text: The hounds whine for a week, then stop. The old hound never eats again, and lies by the east wall until it dies.

options.label: Let the hounds have what they found.

outcomes.text: They eat whatever it was. Afterwards they are bigger, and quieter, and they watch the Scions.
They eat it, and turn on the kennel master's apprentice in the night.
